summary.text: Marc LaHood is a Republican state representative from Texas who has represented District 121 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Marc LaHood was born in San Antonio, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from Trinity University and a law degree from the Saint Mary's University School of Law in 2007.
LaHood assumed office in the Texas House on January 14, 2025, succeeding Steve Allison, a Republican.
Democrat Zack Dunn is also on the 2026 general election ballot for District 121.
